hints.title: Run Two BFS Sweeps
hints.text: The furthest node from any arbitrary starting node in a tree is guaranteed to be one endpoint of the diameter.

hints.title: First Sweep to Find Endpoint
hints.text: Perform a search from node 0 to find node A having the maximum distance.

hints.title: Second Sweep to Measure Diameter
hints.text: Perform a second search starting from node A; the maximum distance discovered is the exact diameter.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Running all-pairs shortest paths takes O(V^2) or O(V^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Two tree traversals find the diameter in linear O(V + E) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should know the double-BFS or DFS method for computing tree diameter.
complexity.notes: An unweighted undirected tree with V nodes has V - 1 edges.
